pull_requests.title: diag(eval): test token-synchronous CTC Viterbi separability
pull_requests.body:
## Purpose

Stop tuning local decoder constants and test a structurally different scoring model before implementing a new embedded decoder.

The current sparse chronological surrogate can cross hundreds of milliseconds between keyword tokens without paying intervening frame probability. #406 showed this is exactly where selected fuzzy paths outrun real token evidence.

This PR adds one development-only scorer:

**max-over-start token-synchronous CTC Viterbi, normalized by target token count**

After the first target token starts a segment:
- every frame is consumed;
- waiting uses actual CTC blank log probability;
- target-token state repeats follow normal CTC collapse;
- adjacent repeated labels require blank separation;
- unequal adjacent labels may transition directly;
- this is Viterbi max-path, **not** a prefix beam / log-sum scorer.

## Evidence

Fixed exact #391 model/source.

Evaluate:
1. the existing 32 retained exact-wake posterior traces;
2. 8 paired within-word-pause positives vs 8 same-voice cross-boundary negatives.

The boundary posterior traces are regenerated from the retained WAVs using the exact #391 `kws_posterior_dump`, not PR-head acoustic code.

## Decision

This is only a structural separability test.

Worth further implementation only if:
- within-word target score is consistently above its paired cross-boundary target score, preferably with clear per-keyword separation;
- exact-wake positives are not systematically dominated by the wrong keyword score.

If either fails, close this diagnostic and do not implement a C runtime decoder from this simple Viterbi formulation. No threshold grid or scorer sweep follows from a negative result.

No training, decoder shipping change, threshold change or protected qualification evidence.

pull_requests.title: diag(eval): screen strict non-root exact-top admission
pull_requests.body:
## Hypothesis

#406 retained evidence shows that selected fuzzy child advances often occur hundreds of milliseconds before the target token's real top-1 spike. Test one counterfactual only:

> once a keyword prefix exists, a child may advance only when that child token is frame top-1.

Root admission, thresholds, model, posteriors, boundary reset, refractory and all training math remain fixed.

## Causal framing

This PR is development-only and ephemeral unless the evidence justifies a full reference-scored follow-up.

The retained screen replays every fixed posterior trace three ways:
1. exact #391 source decoder;
2. current decoder with the debug hook **disabled**;
3. current decoder with strict non-root exact-top admission enabled.

The probe fails closed if (1) and (2) differ on any replay event, proving the new hook changes no default behavior on the retained corpus.

## Screen decision

The strict policy is only **promising** if it recovers at least one retained surrogate-above/runtime positive miss and loses zero existing positive hits. That does **not** authorize a shipping decoder change: a promising screen must next pass a full reference-scored calibration/test FA/FAR evaluation.

If it recovers nothing or loses existing positive hits, close this PR unmerged and do not sweep admission margins.

No protected qualification evidence is used; `selection_feedback_allowed=false`.
